expanded_body:
Originally posted March 17, 2026.

Green beer and poker on St. Patrick's Day.

Between following every twist of The Lodge story in Round Rock and grinding the local rooms across Dallas–Fort Worth, Tuesday night was for getting back on the live felt with a cold green beer on the rail and stacks in play.

May the luck of the Irish be on your side at the tables today.

— Sham
